## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Resolving an escalation offers to save a policy entry, which validates...

The system SHALL ensure that resolving an escalation offers to save a policy entry, which validates against the playbook schema.

#### Scenario: Resolving an escalation offers to save a policy entry, which validates...

WHEN `add-decision-point-policy-playbook-schema-and-capture` is implemented
THEN Resolving an escalation offers to save a policy entry, which validates against the playbook schema.

### Requirement: A policy entry missing a trigger condition, author, or scope fails validation

The system SHALL ensure that a policy entry missing a trigger condition, author, or scope fails validation.

#### Scenario: A policy entry missing a trigger condition, author, or scope fails validation

WHEN `add-decision-point-policy-playbook-schema-and-capture` is implemented
THEN A policy entry missing a trigger condition, author, or scope fails validation.
